core.title: Rustic Sandcast Bronze Door Pull, Emtek 86088
tags: Emtek Rustic Rod Sandcast Bronze Pulls

text.description_html:
Emtek 86088, Rod Sandcast Bronze Door Handle

The Rustic Sandcast Bronze Door Pull is available with an 8 inch or a 12 inch center to center length. This Rustic Door Handle comes packaged with the attached rosettes and the mounting hardware needed to thru-bolt it on a wood, metal, or fiberglass door up to 1-3/4 inches thick. The Rod Sandcast Bronze Door Handle is available in matte black, medium bronze, and tumbled white bronze finishes. Its traditional feel makes it worthy of any old world style door.

Sandcasting is a process for casting metal in sand molds. The mold is made by packing the sand around a pattern. Molten bronze is then poured into a mold cavity formed out of sand. Each sand mold is used only once. The sand is then recycled for the next piece.

Thru-Bolted Mounting: Pull bolts through the door.

Also Available: Rod Pull with Back-to-Back Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Rustic Rod Sandcast Bronze Pull:

  • Material: Sandcast Bronze
  • Door Thickness: for doors up to 1-3/4" thick
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.
  • Comes packaged with (2) 1" long 1/4"-20 screws, (2) 1" long #10-32 screws, (2) 2" #10-32 screws, and (2) screw caps.

Available in 2 Sizes:

    EMT-86088:
    • Center to Center Length: 8"
    • Total Length: 9-13/16"
    • Pull Handle Width: 3/4"
    • Total Projection: 2-9/16"
    • Base: 1-13/16"

    EMT-86068:
    • Center to Center Mount: 12"
    • Total Length: 13-3/4"
    • Pull Handle Width: 3/4"
    • Total Projection: 2-9/16"
    • Base: 1-3/4"
    • Clearance: 1-3/4"

Sold individually with thru-bolt mounting.
